LOGIC ADVENTURE 10 · CLASS 30

Monkey’s Odd-One-Out Market

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Odd one out

Three apples and a banana — at Monkey’s market, tap the picture that is different.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · ODD ONE OUT

Monkey’s Odd-One-Out Market

At Monkey’s market, one thing in each box is different. Tap the odd one out!

One of these fruits is not an apple. Tap it!

One of these is not a carrot. Tap it!

One of these toys is not a teddy bear. Tap it!

Market inspected!

A banana among apples, a cupcake among carrots, a car among teddies.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

The printed sheet puts the odd item third in every row, so the game shuffles the stalls — your child compares the items themselves.

Prefer paper? The Monkey’s Odd-One-Out Market worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
